sentences.text:
======================================================
 Md. Yasin S/O Mahmood Alam R/O Village- Islampur, Ward No.-15,
 P.S- Singheshwar, Distt.- Madhepura.

Versus
 1. The State of Bihar

2. Farjana Pravin W/O Md. Yasin, D/O Abdul Sattar R/O Village- Islampur,
 Ward No.-15, P.S- Sinhgeshwar, Distt.- Madhepura at present resident of
 Madhepura, Ward No. 11, Faridabad mohalla, P.S and Distt.- Madhepura.
 ... ... Opposite Party/s

=
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Bam Bahadur Jha, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mrs.Shaheen Begum, App
 Mr.Uday Chand Prasad, Adv.
 Mrs.Pooja Prasad, Adv.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable u/s 341, 323,
498A, 504, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Petitioner, who is husband of informant, is said to have tortured the informant and ousted her from the matrimonial home in association of his family members over dowry demand.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.46707 of 2023(3) dt.19-09-2023 drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.

The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar,
reported in 2006 (3) PLJR 182.

sentences.text:
In that view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Madhepura P.S. Case No.137 of 2023, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
6.
Petitioner is ready to pay Rs.4000.00 (Rupees Four Thousand) per month to the informant in the second week of every month.
If the petitioner fails to pay the aforesaid amount on two consecutive months, informant shall be at liberty to move before the learned Court below for cancelling the bail bond of the petitioner.

7. It goes without saying that the aforesaid payment shall be Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.46707 of 2023(3) dt.19-09-2023 subject to any order being passed in matrimonial maintenance case or any other collateral proceedings.
8. Learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 is directed to furnish the bank account details of the informant before the learned Court below.
If she fails to furnish the same, the aforesaid amount will be deposited in the learned Court below which will be released in favour of the informant after she furnishes her bank account details.

9. If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the learned Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Center for the purpose of reconciliation or one time settlement.
10. With the aforesaid observation and direction, this application stands disposed of.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) pallavi/-
